notes.title: Clank! Digital 2.1.0 Patch Notes - Draft Mode!
notes.content: [p][b]Stop right there, thief![/b] You’ll want to download the latest patch before you go robbing any more dragons! Today’s update is jam-packed, featuring all the usual bug fixes and improvements, plus something new…[/p][p]…That’s right! We’re very excited to release the brand-new multiplayer [b]Draft Mode![/b] Pick 7 cards to craft a powerful starting deck and get a head start on your dungeon diving! Keep reading to learn more about this exciting new mode, as well as the many other fixes and improvements we’ve brought to [i]Clank! Digital[/i] in 2.1.0![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/a28c24d63891d3152b2bbdfb6825cbdbaf5c8881.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Feature - Draft Mode[/h2][p]If you’ve ever played the [b]Professionally Prepared [/b]challenge in the base game, or the [b]Deep Sea Mission[/b] challenge in [i]Sunken Treasures,[/i] Draft Mode will feel a bit familiar. These challenges allow you to draft [b]seven[/b] [b]cards [/b]at the beginning of the game (along with [b]three Stumbles[/b]) to form your starting deck, and [b]this functionality now comes to multiplayer games![/b][/p][p]To play the new Draft Mode, simply [b]select the “Draft Mode” checkbox during game creation. [/b]This mode is available in [b]all online multiplayer games[/b], both [b]live [/b]and [b]async, [/b]and in local [b]pass and play.[/b] (It isn’t available in solo games versus the AI - if you want to play Draft against computer opponents, the challenges are already there for you!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/555ad9261d8ade532bc710bc03acac9b0990402b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Note that in these games, starting decks are more powerful and games are often high-scoring. As a balancing measure, this means that you’ll draw [b]four cards[/b] every round instead of the usual [b]five. [/b][/p][p][b]This has been one of our most-requested features across all of our games,[/b] so we’re happy to be able to bring it to you, free for all players![/p][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Took a holistic pass on room and tunnel hinting to improve clarity, particularly around the secret tunnels which wrap around the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced length of the teleport animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added greyed-out versions of sold-out market items, allowing you to tooltip them even when they’ve all been bought.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Sunken Treasures[/i] avatars are now available to be selected in all lobbies, regardless of the expansions used. (Limiting them to [i]Sunken Treasures[/i] lobbies was always meant to be a temporary fix for a graphical issue which has since been resolved, so there’s no reason to keep them locked away anymore!)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the prompting in the [b]Weighed Down[/b] challenge to make it clearer why you’re discarding a card at the start of your turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Medium graphics quality setting to Android devices.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]The Burrow Mounds map preview should now display its artifacts in the correct locations.[/p][/*][*][p]The game should no longer fail to display results in cases where all players escape or are KO’d.[/p][/*][*][p]The tiebreaker rule should be fixed – previously it was giving the win to the player with the highest total value of artifacts, it should now correctly give the win to the player with the highest-value single artifact.[/p][/*][*][p]If you are KO’d in the depths and use the skip to results feature, when you press Show Map, it should now show the map updated to the end of game state.[/p][/*][*][p]The Submariner Heist modifier should now properly count every SCUBA tunnel you crossed.[/p][/*][*][p]You should now be able to undo the discard portion of Fishing Pole’s ability.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI should now choose to defeat the Goldfish instead of the Goblin when it is able to.[/p][/*][*][p]If you undo purchasing a Crown, Mountain King’s icons should now disappear. (Note that this was a visual issue only and was not affecting the resources the card actually granted.)[/p][/*][*][p]The secret tunnel highlights on the Shipwreck map should now hint the correct icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of several one-way arrows on the [i]Sunken Treasures[/i] maps to ensure they aren’t covered by player icons or other hinting.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the hint colors for Deep Dive’s multi-discard prompt to make them easier to differentiate for certain kinds of colorblindness.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some localization and markup errors in action log items in non-English languages.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fast Mode toggle’s tooltip should now properly display in your selected language instead of only appearing in English.[/p][/*][*][p]Flying Carpet should no longer erroneously believe it has flavor text.[/p][/*][*][p]Your own chat messages should no longer cause you to see the “new message” icon when you close the chat window.[/p][/*][*][p]Push notifications for the start of your turn should now be properly delivered on iOS and Android devices.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We appreciate your continued support and dedication to making [i]Clank! Digital [/i]the best experience it can be! If you encounter anything in-game that seems a bit off, drop us a line in the [url="https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital"]Dire Wolf Discord,[/url] via the in-game feedback option, or via email to [url="https://support@direwolfdigital.com"]support@direwolfdigital.com[/url].[/p][p]Thanks for playing [i]Clank! Digital[/i], and happy gaming![/p]

notes.title: Clank! Digital 2.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today’s Clank! Digital patch includes some bug fixes.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Heist Leaderboard should now correctly display Gold badges for the top 100 players.
[*] The Free Diver achievement should now only be obtainable when playing on DLC maps.
[*] In the Wandering Monster challenge, monsters in the expanded dungeon row should now display correctly.
[*] Players should now only be able to send invites for DLC games to friends who also own the DLC. (Note that this does not change who can actually join DLC games - previously, sending an invite to a player without the DLC gave them a purchase notification.)
[*] Sending a DLC game invite to a friend who also owns the DLC should now show the notification for them to join.
[*] Sunken Treasures DLC should now display correctly on the Steam store page.
[/list]

We appreciate your continued support and dedication to making [i]Clank! Digital[/i] the best experience it can be! If you encounter anything in game that seems a bit funky, drop us a line using the in-game feedback option, or via email to support@direwolfdigital.com.

Thanks for playing [i]Clank! Digital,[/i] and happy gaming!

notes.title: Clank! Digital 2.0 Patch Notes - Dive into Sunken Treasures!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/605c302003555a01842545af918d17e054eeb97b.png[/img]
Today’s [i]Clank! Digital[/i] patch includes a host of improvements and bug fixes as well as a brand-new expansion!

[i]Sunken Treasures[/i] plunges would-be thieves into flooded caverns, leaving them to swim for their lives. Recruit fresh companions with unique abilities to help your journey, but beware of the aquatic monsters who are lurking in the depths to dampen your spirits. Fight your way through to glory, or be forever lost to a watery demise!

[b][i]Clank! Sunken Treasures[/i] expansion includes the following:[/b]
[list]
[*] Two Maps - filled with treasure, flooded rooms, and tunnels that will make you Clank!
[*] 35 Dungeon Cards
[*] 1 Reserve Monster - Goldfish 
[*] 2 Minor Secrets
[*] 1 Major Secret
[*] Market Item - SCUBA!
[*] New Challenges and Heists 
[/list]
[h3]New Feature - View Paths[/h3]
Available to all players regardless of expansion ownership, you can now view a visualization of the paths each player takes through the dungeon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/54eeb1a8d20cbd6d6581059fa8136ccc7eb34644.png[/img]
[list]
[*] During the game, click or tap a player’s pawn to view their path from the start of the game.
[*] On the score screen, use the “show map” button, then either view paths one at a time with the above method, or press the “show paths” button to see every player’s path at once!
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved performance for lower end devices.
[*] Adjusted mobile screen display and UI scaling to prevent cut-off visuals.
[*] Improved AI to make more reasonable movement and purchasing decisions.
[*] Tweaked a handful of automatic camera movements to be less jarring.
[*] All cards with conditional abilities now display updated details in green. (Previously this affected some cards, but not others, leading to inconsistency.)
[*] Prevented triggered tutorial prompts from displaying in online multiplayer matches.
[*] Added toggles to turn off tooltips and warning prompts.
[*] Clarified certain hinting, including a new visual for locked paths when you have a key item from the market.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Burgling Empire and Infamous Thief achievements can now be unlocked in Challenges.
[*] Achievements should now sync correctly on Android.
[*] Certain achievements should no longer be unlocked via abusing the undo feature.
[*] The Heist score modifier Point Driven should now correctly calculate cards with variable VP.
[*] The Heist score modifier Loud Mouth should now correctly calculate Clank when under certain conditions.
[*] Wand of the Wind’s ability should no longer be optional.
[*] Teleporting to the exit should no longer cause a softlock.
[*] The countdown track reminder should continue to display upon resuming a match if a player had previously escaped or died.
[*] Improved how devices appear in the action log.
[*] Updated player hud spacing to better visualize all elements.
[*] Adjusted hold/hover to zoom display for mobile devices to help prevent card hangers from being covered.
[*] Adjusted some confusing wording in the prompt displayed when the last card in hand has a discard effect.
[*] Adjusted the tooltip regarding timer lengths.
[*] Czech and Polish characters should now use the correct font.
[/list]
We appreciate your continued support and dedication to making [i]Clank! Digital[/i] the best experience it can be! If you encounter anything in game that seems a bit funky, drop us a line using the in-game feedback option, or via email to support@direwolfdigital.com.
Thanks for playing [i]Clank! Digital,[/i] and happy gaming!

notes.title: Clank! Digital Patch Notes 1.3.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/8f3676fa4148c91faabce68fbd11e10477557598.png[/img]

The newest Clank! Digital patch introduces a handful of fixes for issues identified by the community.

[b]Fixes and Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a warning at end of turn if there are still boots or swords that can be used.
[*] Heist now properly gives you the score bonus for first place if you tie.
[*] Fixed an issue where your deck and discard pile contents could disappear.
[*] Player items should no longer appear cut off in any resolution.
[*] Adjusted animation so cubes don’t decrement early and spoil the results of a dragon attack.
[*] Fixed an issue in Pass and Play where the next player’s hand would display briefly before passing.
[*] Online and AI indicator icon now displays in multiplayer matches.
[*] Fixed some icons in the game creation preview of the Burrow Mounds map.
[*] Fixed an issue where the timer could remain on screen in multiplayer matches.
[/list]

We appreciate your continued support and dedication to making Clank! Digital the best experience it can be! If you encounter anything in game that seems a bit funky, drop us a line using the in-game feedback option, or via email to support@direwolfdigital.com.

Thanks for playing Clank! Digital, and happy gaming!

notes.title: [Updated] Clank! Digital Patch Notes 1.3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/fed32f964aa9909a605ddad6759a3f151bffc6f0.png[/img]

If heists, dragons, and treasure sound like the perfect way to spend the holidays, then you’re in luck! Our latest update for Clank! Digital is here, featuring a new addition and a treasure trove of bug fixes. Time to sharpen those blades, polish those boots, and test your luck!

[h1]New Features & Improvements[/h1]
[list][*] Introducing the Skip Replay feature! 
[list] [*] Now you can jump straight to the present when rejoining an online game, without having to watch the replay of what happened while you were away.[/list][/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Players in Live lobbies should now be removed when they accept an invite to another live game.
[*] Players should no longer be able to interact with main menu buttons while the Friend’s Menu is open, preventing misclicks.
[*] Extra Dragon attacks (from things like Mister Whiskers or the Countdown Track) should now properly add gold to cards in the Dungeon Row in Gold Fever.
[*] Improved visibility of gold values on cards in the Gold Fever Challenge.
[*] Tutorial prompts should no longer be overlapped by cards in the dungeon row.
[*] The AI’s gold should now calculate correctly at the end of the game. Previously, the AI could gain extra during scoring if they had cards which generated gold.
[*] Fixed non-English localization for inventory tool tip.
[*] Heist Close Call modifier should now update your potential score during play. This was a visual issue only and did not impact actual scores.
[*] Belcher’s defeat popup now correctly displays the Clank! received. This was a visual issue only and did not affect the Clank! players were receiving.
[*] Discard pile’s title should now display correctly if automatically selected by trash modal.
[*] Enabling Fast Mode should no longer affect tutorial games.
[*] Clarified hinting of  the wraparound tunnel in the tutorial.
[*] Tunnel monsters should now auto-select in later portions of the tutorial if you have the related toggle on.
[*] Removed redundant tutorial  prompt explaining minus Clank!
[*] In Pass & Play matches, the rage track will remember whether each player left it open or closed and automatically change accordingly when moving to that player’s turn.
[*] Heist modifier Healbot’s in-game scoring text should now displays correctly. This was a visual issue only and did not impact actual scores.
[/list]
[h2]Gamepad[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can no longer select the nameplate of a closed slot in a Pass and Play game.
[*] Improved highlights on tutorial prompts, tunnel monsters, and inventory items.
[*] RT reminder icon now displays for expanding trash modal prompt.
[*] Using RT to Collapse/Expand a prompt no longer zooms the camera.
[*] Players can now use RB/LB to move between inventories.
[*] Improved Use Later button’s visuals with gamepad.
[*] Audio tab button should now display correctly on Steamdeck.
[/list]

Key Note: We listed the following as fixed in this patch when that is not correct. This bug will be fixed in an upcoming patch. Thank you for understanding. 
[*] In Pass & Play matches, the next player’s hand no longer displays until after the splash screen.

notes.title: October 2024 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/83b773789d68c9cd86077e6154a205337242d338.png[/img]

October is here, and with it comes all sorts of treats, including [b][i]Clank! Digital’s[/i][/b] introduction to iOs and Android platforms! Along with this exciting news, we’ve added a couple of smooth changes to enhance your dungeon-crawling experience! This patch focuses on increasing game speed, refining visuals, and introducing new features to help you plan the optimal heist strategies. 

[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1][list]
[*][i][b]Clank! Digital[/b][/i] is now available on iOS and Android![/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list]
[*] Various changes to icons, highlighting action buttons, and other UX improvements. 
[*] Various Translation and Localization Fixes: Improvements made for Spanish, Polish,  localization to enhance player experience.
[*] Visual feedback should now show when Players buy cards from Expanded Dungeon row. 
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Skill points from Swagger should now be countered for Skill Shot on heist matches.[/list]
[h2]Challenge Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The number of gold on Dungeon Row should now display properly when reaching 10 or above in Gold Fever Challenge. 
[*] The Market Window should now stay open when Player moves to a non-Market location on Map. 
[/list]
[h2]AI: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Opponents can no longer use Mister Whiskers for Dragon Attacks after all other players are escaped or dead  (and hurt themselves. Ouch!) 
[*] AI should no longer move back and forth between rooms without targeting incorrect Artifact.
[/list]
[h2]Art: 
[/h2][list]
[*]Knocked out Player is no longer blocking UI. 
[/list]

notes.title: Clank! Digital August Hotfix 2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/990073d59c320d5636d52a995046d9b1577ed07e.png[/img]

Thieves–you’re under arrest! Ah-ha, just kidding. Today’s patch is chock-full of numerous fixes and improvements to make your [i]- ahem -[/i] high-stakes antiques reallocation smoother and more pleasant.

[h1]Additions and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tweaked and replaced several Heist modifiers for a more varied experience.
[*] Overhauled the auto-camera behavior to stay out of your way when you don’t want it, and be more useful when you do.
[*] Adjusted the spacing of rooms and tunnels on the Barrow Mounds board to reduce the need for panning around.
[*] Created additional VFX for certain character movements and actions to make the characters more reactive to game events.
[*] Added images to take up edge borders when the game window is dynamically scaled, replacing the blank black which previously appeared.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] In addition to the above improvements, we’ve done a lot of bug-squashing. 
[*] First-time trigger tutorials for deferred abilities should now properly appear when first encountering one.
[*] Resolved an interaction between the Heist modifiers Scholar and Hall of Mirrors which caused incorrect leaderboard scoring to occur. In-game scores were unaffected.
[*] You are no longer referred to as just “You” when not logged in.
[*] Fixed an issue where skipping to results could cause some iconography to be hidden on the scoring screen. This was a visual problem only and did not affect final scores.
[/list]

notes.title: Clank! Digital August Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019515/61af0e820c0ec0adbd46f0848195e58c8a6ea589.png[/img]

[i]Clank! [/i]fans, lace up those leather-soled boots and sharpen your daggers. We have a hotfix for you with some improvements and bug fixes. We greatly appreciate your enthusiasm for the game and keen eye for bugs. Please do share your feedback and any bugs so that we can give you the best Clank! dungeon-diving adventure possible.

[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Font-sizing for Steam Deck should now be improved.
[*] The Clank! Digital Store listing should now show all supported languages.
[*] The Challenge subheader now uses correct grammar.
[*] The Getaway section of the rules now includes the Mastery Token icon.
[*] Gameplay: Using Enter to send chat messages in the lobby should no longer start the game.
[*] Gameplay: Completing a Heist attempt should now show the correct score from previous attempts.
[*] Gameplay: Heist mods Scholar and Hall of Mirrors should now score correctly when both are active.
[*] Gameplay: In Mining Incident, the AI should no longer cause a freeze when no paths lead to Artifacts / Escape.
[*] Gameplay: Setup for Solo Play and Pass and Play game modes should no longer include the turn timer.
[*] Gameplay: Using a controller with Shrine and Dragon Shrine should now let players end their turn.
[/list]

Your feedback matters to us! If you encounter any problems, please contact us through the in-game feedback option, via email to support@direwolfdigital.com, or here on Steam. Thanks again for playing [i]Clank![/i] [b]Stay tuned for more rollicking dungeon fun![/b]

notes.title: Delightful deckbuilder Clank! now has a digital version
notes.content: Everyone has at some point thought about what it would be like as a fantasy burglar crawling down into a monster-infested dungeon to make off with heaps of loot, all while not waking up the terrible dragon that dwells within. Don't you dare tell me you haven't or my perception of reality will be absolutely ruined... Read more.

notes.title: Quiet those boots, Early Access is here!
notes.content:
Enter the dungeon and lace up those boots: it’s time to begin your [i]Clank! Digital[/i] adventure! Your journey into Early Access begins with your deck, five cards, and all of the tricks and surprises you’ve come to know in the [i]Clank![/i] board game.

As you dive in, be sure to leave us your feedback in the forums. Additionally, if you see something buggy, you can send them through the in-game feedback menu, via email to Support@DireWolfDigital.com, or report them in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1722870/discussions/0/4520009413784816506/]Bugs Thread[/url].
